banned_words_scope: Exact whole directory segments and file stems (the part before the first dot). Compound names such as snapshot-compat or common_types stay valid.

asset_id.applies_to: Ids of non-code assets: skill, workflow and command names.

versioning.rule: Never add a v<N> token to a name; versions live only as <name>/v<N> folders or files, and only for what must be reproduced or compared.

sources.contributed: banned words utils, helpers, manager, misc, common, new, old, legacy, compat, fallback; v<N> only as <name>/v<N>; child never repeats parent; plural only for catalogues (skills, references, commands, tests); snake_case Python, kebab-case asset ids; no version, date or ticket names
grab-bag folders common, utils, misc, helpers; one root test folder with fixtures beside the tests

sources.source: oh-mi-pi-config commit d84e943, setup-repository-guardrails Python reference v1 quality checker (PYQ103/PYQ104)
sources.contributed: generic names common, helpers, misc, stuff, temp

sources.source: raidar tag guardrails-v1-final, structure and Python-quality checkers under scripts/checks
sources.contributed: version token pattern (?<![A-Za-z0-9])v\d+(?![A-Za-z0-9]); generic names common, helpers, misc, stuff, temp; PascalCase classes and snake_case functions; kebab-case skill directories and commands; plural data trees experiments, problems, agents, workflows, stages
forbidden names utils, manager, new, old, legacy, compat, fallback; generic names common, helpers, misc, stuff, temp; attached suffix pattern (?<=.)[-_]?v\d+$ with standalone <name>/v<N> allowed
kebab-case TypeScript files and directories; kebab-case or upper-case Markdown names; *.test.ts as the only runnable TypeScript test suffix, with .spec and other test-like suffixes rejected
test files mirror their owner and carry no ticket, version or date tokens; support and fixtures live at the profile's locations
